#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reconcile the separate 56-observation, five-second H1 confirmation cohort.

This script never generates load. It does not pool confirmation observations
with the main 15-second Hyper/Axum campaign. Use --write only after completion.
"""
import argparse,collections,csv,hashlib,json,math,statistics
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]; ART=ROOT/'artifacts/performance-2026-10-20'; RAW=ROOT/'artifacts/bench'; OUT=ROOT/'benches/results'
parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__);parser.add_argument('--write',action='store_true');args=parser.parse_args()
HASHES={'baseline':'be05e0aea314cfdda839441c4c3c923e4cae9c8100f4836f382d7ca1e703e8f2','candidate':'c0205e565b99b30488c07de092d1df4b601a89ecac588f49b7f251889e567f18'}
PATHS={0:'/plaintext',1:'/users/42',3:'/echo'}; METRICS=['rps','cpu_us_per_request','p50_ms','p99_ms','p999_ms','rss_kib','peak_rss_kib','cpu_interval_seconds','server_cpu_percent','client_cpu_percent'];seen=set()
def require(test,message):
 if not test:raise ValueError(message)
def read_json(p):seen.add(p);return json.loads(p.read_text())
def read_csv(p):seen.add(p);return list(csv.DictReader(p.open()))
def metric(d,k,f):return d['metrics'][k]['values'][f]
def validate_json(p,row=None):
 d=read_json(p);n=metric(d,'http_reqs','count')
 require(isinstance(n,(int,float)) and math.isfinite(n) and n>0 and n==int(n),f'{p}: invalid response count')
 require(metric(d,'checks','passes')==n and metric(d,'checks','fails')==0,f'{p}: body/status validation')
 require(metric(d,'http_req_failed','passes')==metric(d,'network_errors','count')==metric(d,'status_error_responses','count')==0,f'{p}: HTTP/network errors')
 if row:
  require(float(row['requests'])==n,f'{p}: count mismatch')
  for col,key,field in [('rps','http_reqs','rate'),('p50_ms','http_req_duration','med'),('p99_ms','http_req_duration','p(99)'),('p999_ms','http_req_duration','p(99.9)')]:require(math.isclose(float(row[col]),metric(d,key,field),rel_tol=1e-9,abs_tol=1e-8),f'{p}: {col} mismatch')
 return d
expected={f'core-h2-confirm-{repeat}-{case}-{variant}' for repeat in range(12) for case in ([1,3]+([0] if repeat%3==0 else [])) for variant in ['baseline','candidate']}
outcomes=read_json(RAW/'core-h2-confirm-outcomes.json')
require(len(outcomes)==56 and {x['label'] for x in outcomes}==expected,'expected exactly all 56 confirmation outcomes')
require(all(x['passed'] and x['exit']==0 for x in outcomes),'failed confirmation targets retained; no accepted export')
rows=[];envs=[]
for item in outcomes:
 repeat,case,variant=item['repeat'],item['case'],item['variant'];label=item['label']
 require(label==f'core-h2-confirm-{repeat}-{case}-{variant}','outcome identity mismatch')
 env=read_json(RAW/f'{label}-environment.json');envs.append(env);a=env['args']
 wanted=dict(generator='wrk',protocol='plain',duration='5s',workers=1,vus=64,body_bytes=1024,rates='0',client_cpus='1,2',sample_seconds=0,repeats=1,engines='dynamic',paths=PATHS[case])
 require(all(a[k]==v for k,v in wanted.items()),f'{label}: wrong confirmation configuration')
 require(env['binary_sha256'].split()[0]==HASHES[variant],f'{label}: wrong binary')
 rr=read_csv(RAW/f'{label}.csv');require(len(rr)==1,f'{label}: expected one dynamic-engine row');r=rr[0]
 require((r['generator'],r['protocol'],r['engine'],r['path'],int(r['body_bytes']),r['workers'],r['offered_rps'],r['repeat'])==('wrk','plain','dynamic',PATHS[case],1024 if case==3 else 0,'1','0','0'),f'{label}: CSV configuration mismatch')
 require(all(float(r[k])==0 for k in ['failures','checks_failed','network_errors','dropped','exit']),f'{label}: failed row')
 require(r['iterations_started']==r['iterations_completed']=='',f'{label}: invented wrk iteration counter')
 require(all(math.isfinite(float(r[k])) and float(r[k])>=0 for k in METRICS),f'{label}: invalid metric')
 stem=f"{label}-dynamic-{PATHS[case].strip('/').replace('/','-')}-w1-r0-n0"
 validate_json(RAW/f'{stem}-warmup.json');validate_json(RAW/f'{stem}.json',r)
 for suffix in ['.log','-client-cpu.txt']:
  p=RAW/f'{stem}{suffix}';require(p.exists(),f'missing raw artifact {p}');seen.add(p)
 rows.append(dict(trial_label=label,variant=variant,campaign_round=repeat,case=case,**r))
reference=read_json(RAW/'core-h2-wrk-0-0-baseline-environment.json')
for env in envs:
 require(env['workload_sha256']==reference['workload_sha256'],'confirmation workload differs from main H1 cohort')
 require(env['image_ids']==reference['image_ids'],'confirmation Rust/client image identity differs from main H1 cohort')
require(set(reference['image_ids'])=={'rust:1.96-bookworm','maximus-tools:latest'},'missing Rust/client image reference')
bykey={(r['case'],r['campaign_round'],r['variant']):r for r in rows};pairs=[]
for case in PATHS:
 rounds=[i for i in range(12) if case!=0 or i%3==0]
 for repeat in rounds:
  b=bykey[(case,repeat,'baseline')];c=bykey[(case,repeat,'candidate')]
  pairs.append(dict(case=case,round=repeat,baseline=b['trial_label'],candidate=c['trial_label'],percent_changes={m:100*(float(c[m])/float(b[m])-1) for m in METRICS}))
require(len(pairs)==28,'expected 28 matched pairs')
def stats(rs):return {m:dict(median=statistics.median(xs),minimum=min(xs),maximum=max(xs),samples=xs) for m in METRICS for xs in [[float(r[m]) for r in rs]]}
groups=collections.defaultdict(list)
for r in rows:groups[(r['case'],r['variant'])].append(r)
summaries=[dict(case=k[0],path=PATHS[k[0]],variant=k[1],n=len(v),statistics=stats(v)) for k,v in groups.items()]
plan=ART/'confirm-core-h2.py';seen.add(plan)
result=dict(cohort='core-h2-confirm',duration_seconds=5,comparison='same frozen baseline/tuple binaries, Maximus dynamic only',scope='independent confirmation of adverse H1 capture and echo observations; four plaintext control pairs',primary_comparator_cohort='core-h2-wrk; 15-second Hyper/Axum comparisons remain separate',pooling='never pooled with main 15-second observations',status='observations reconciled; acceptance needs assessment of adverse results',observations=56,matched_pairs=28,checked_responses=sum(int(r['requests']) for r in rows),binary_hashes=HASHES,outcomes=outcomes,summaries=summaries,pairs=pairs,environment_reference=reference,artifact_sha256={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(seen)},analysis_script=Path(__file__).read_text())
print(json.dumps({k:result[k] for k in ['status','observations','matched_pairs','checked_responses']},indent=2))
if args.write:
 with (OUT/'core-h2-confirm-trials.csv').open('w') as f:w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(rows[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
 (OUT/'core-h2-confirm-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
